exposure.input_handling: The sole authorized file was opened once. Later hashing used an in-memory transcription of the already-visible parsed packet, checked against the full canonical digest measured on that read; no second file read occurred.

freezing: Exclusive first creation, fsync, permissions 0444, with user immutable flag when the host exposes that facility. Outputs are not subsequently rewritten.

hash_rules.decoder_run_sha256: SHA256 of canonical run.json object after removing only decoder_run_sha256, before pretty-printing.
hash_rules.input_canonical_json_sha256: SHA256 of entire parsed packet, including packet_sha256, serialized as UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, ensure_ascii=False, compact separators, no trailing newline.
hash_rules.input_raw_sha256: SHA256 of exact bytes read once from input.json.
hash_rules.packet_sha256: SHA256 with the same canonical JSON rules after removing only the top-level packet_sha256 field; verified against the supplied digest.
hash_rules.reconstructed_text_sha256: SHA256 of exact UTF-8 bytes of reconstruction.md, including its final newline. reconstructed_theorem_text is those same bytes decoded as UTF-8.

outputs.content: Actor/run identity, input hashes, exact reconstruction text and hash, structured scope and dependency reconstruction
This exposure/input manifest; its byte SHA256 is reported out of band to avoid self-reference

task_context_visible: Scoped delegation instructions supplied the exact authorized input path, expected raw SHA256, output directory, and required blindness constraints. General execution/tool instructions and environment metadata were visible. No original theorem/source identity was supplied or sought.
